entities.name: ContextRotArchitecture
observations: Context rot occurs in 1M+ token windows when softmax denominator sums over 10^6 logits, causing entropy collapse H(A_i) -> log2(N) and attention dilution.
The 'Lost in the Middle' effect drops multi-hop reasoning by 60-75% when critical facts sit between 15% and 85% context depth.
RoPE positional embeddings suffer frequency phase wrapping and aliasing beyond 200k tokens, impairing exact positional indexing.
Effective reasoning capacity sharply degrades once context exceeds 20-30% of advertised limit.
Multi-turn agent noise (verbose tool outputs, failed attempts, intermediate logs) acts as semantic distractors that saturate attention heads.

entities.name: ContextRotMitigation
observations: Hierarchical Indexing: High-density executive context maps (SESSION_CONTEXT_MAP.md) act as deterministic roadmap.
Graph Memory: Dual-layer memory using MCP Knowledge Graph and Graphify AST keeps relational knowledge queryable without dumping raw text.
Sub-turn Retrieval: query_session_context.py retrieves targeted semantic segments under 500 tokens instead of reading 1.54 MB raw files.
Invariant State Freezing: Settled mathematical and engineering decisions are frozen and shielded from conversational drift.
Local Zero-Token Offloading: Auxiliary agents run via gemini-web2api on port 8081 to prevent context pollution in the main coordinator.

entities.name: Strategy_S1_LiquidationCascade
observations: Signal condition: long_liq_zscore > 1.8 and zc_div > 0.8 and delta_spot > 0 and delta_futures < 0 and rsi < 40 and vwap_zscore < -0.5.
Microstructure Exit: Phase 0 breakeven ratchet moves stop to entry + 0.15R at +0.8R price gain; profit lock moves stop to +0.80R at +1.5R; target +2.5R exit; 24-bar time decay.
Portfolio Concurrency: Maximum 2 simultaneous open positions across all 18 parallel symbols.
Performance: 18,456 trades across 18 assets yielded 54.6% win rate and +146.2R net profit.

entities.name: Engine_2_Backtesting_System
observations: 18 institutional Binance USDT-M assets: BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, SUI, NEAR, APT, PEPE, WIF, TIA, ARB, OP, INJ.
Dataset size: 3,464,074 15-minute bars (93.9M data points), zero nulls, strictly monotonic timestamps, stored in Engine_2/binance_backtesting_data/.
Walk-forward: 20 non-overlapping 1-month OOS test windows from March 2021 to April 2026.
Purge Boundary: Strictly enforced 72-hour trade resolution purge gap (t_purge = t_start - 72h) matching max 288-bar trade duration.

entities.name: Empirical_Root_Causes_Failure
observations: Root Cause 1 (5R Retracement Trap): Static stop at -1.0R until +2.5R gain caused 85.8% of winning trades to retrace into full losses.
Root Cause 2 (Asymmetric Risk Sizing): Setting BASE_RISK=$75 on a $225 (4.5%) budget tripped circuit breaker after 3 losses, locking out 19/20 windows.
Root Cause 3 (Falling Knives): Fading liquidation flushes without Spot CVD divergence caught cascading sell-offs with 1.12R MAE.
Root Cause 4 (Simulator Label Contamination): Training LightGBM on flawed 5R simulator labels yielded out-of-sample AUC of 0.487.

entities.name: Arena_GLM_Audit_Directives
observations: Engine_2/s1_liquidation_cascade.py verified as CLEAN with ZERO LOOKAHEAD in temporal splits, point-in-time merges, and in-sample calibration.
verify_sequential_w1_w20.py quarantined and permanently deleted due to researcher selection leakage and test-set nlargest overrides.
Remediation Mandates R-1 to R-8 enforce unified causal execution under one single fixed risk configuration across all 20 windows.

entities.name: Skill_KarpathyGuidelines
observations: Think Before Coding: Don't assume, surface tradeoffs, state assumptions explicitly, ask when confused.
Simplicity First: Minimum code that solves the problem, no speculative abstractions, no unrequested configurability.
Surgical Changes: Touch only what you must, match existing style, clean up only your own mess.
Goal-Driven Execution: Transform tasks into verifiable success criteria, tests-first, loop until verified.

entities.name: Skill_CleanCode
observations: Enforces clean, non-bloated, highly readable, modular architecture across all Python and TypeScript files.
Mandates surgical modifications and immediate pruning of unused imports, variables, or functions.
